sisyphus.prompt_append:
⚠️ READ FILE: AGENTS.md (mandatory rules table). Then SISYPHUS_RULES.md.

📏 CODE QUALITY: After editing code files, if file > ~300 lines → review for SRP/DRY/OOP violations. Clean code slightly exceeding is OK. Docs/config/migrations have no limit.

🔍 UNDERSTAND FLOW FIRST: Before fixing ANY bug or implementing features, research the RELEVANT flow for the topic (e.g., DB schema→migration→repo→service, or API→SDK→handler→service, or backend→API→frontend — depends on what you're working on). NEVER guess — trace with evidence. If you fix the same thing twice, STOP: you don't understand the flow. Use @explore for codebase, @librarian for external docs.

✅ NO PREMATURE DONE: Before saying 'done', self-check: (1) ALL changes verified with evidence? (2) Any remaining TODOs? (3) Anything improvable I'm skipping? (4) Did I TEST or just ASSUME? (5) Re-read original task — fully addressed? If ANY answer is no → NOT done, keep working.
